title: Purple Mage Warrior
description: A young woman with white hair in twin buns stands in a dynamic combat pose against a solid gray background. She wears white and purple traditional armor with bone-like accents, her right hand glowing with purple magic while her left holds a chain of purple energy, surrounded by floating arcane symbols and sparks.
prompt: A fierce young East Asian woman with long white hair styled in two buns and braids, wearing ornate white and purple East Asian-inspired armor with bone decorations and a flowing cape. She stands in a wide combat stance, right hand extended casting glowing purple arcane energy with floating crescent moon symbols, left hand holding a chain of purple lightning. Purple magical halo above her head, dynamic pose, solid gray background, vibrant digital illustration style.
